body.statement: Over \(\mathcal M\), with no upper restriction on the relative growth of \(T_N\) and \(N\), uniformly in \((p,\gamma)\in\mathcal P\times[-G,G]\), \(\big(\sqrt{NT_N}(\widehat\theta_N-\theta_N),\sqrt{NT_N}(\widehat p-p)^{\mathsf T}\big)^{\mathsf T}\) converges to a centered Gaussian vector with covariance \(\begin{pmatrix}V&A^{\mathsf T}\Gamma\\\Gamma A&\Gamma\end{pmatrix}\), and \(I_{\mathrm{emp}}\) covers \(\theta_N\) with probability \(1-\alpha+o(1)\) uniformly. This strictly strengthens Boutilier, Jonasson, Li, and Yoeli's fixed-\(N\), \(T\to\infty\) occupation theorem for the identical model by allowing system size and duration to diverge jointly and compact-uniformly in the critical staffing window.
body.justification: The exact prelimit Poisson martingale removes the need to approximate trajectories over the growing horizon and yields the marked-score covariance on the joint array.
body.gap: Boutilier et al. separate fixed-system sampling from fluid scaling; Wang and Plechac fix one CTMC and do not supply this critical finite-source covariance kernel.
body.consumer: Investigators can analyze a critically loaded service trial using the dependence induced by shared capacity rather than participant-level independence.
